source_title: Luftwaffe strength and serviceability tables August 1938-April 1945
source_reference: RAF Air Historical Branch translation 107, from German Luftwaffe Quartermaster General's Department VI Abteilung returns
pdf_page_numbering: one-based PDF page; scan's printed table page is one less
temporal_scope: selected dated observations across 1938–45; NOT a continuous time series
denominator: aircraft counted by the original compiled German return; not combat missions, production, or combat-unit establishment

quality_flags.issue: The source page heading says the interval ends 3 January 1942 but its column label says 3 January 1941, a printed year typo. Kept as 1942 based on the chronological sequence.

Confirmed error in the printed original (PDF page 43, not merely OCR): reported non-transport total 8,103, but sum of all ten aircraft-role rows is 7,203; serviceable role rows correctly sum to 5,317. Non-transport on-hand is overstated by 900; reported whole-force total 8,586 is correspondingly 900 higher than the independently summed 7,686. KEEP REPORTED NUMBERS here for provenance and EXCLUDE date from charts pending correction with German original.

Source lists non-transport aircraft only; transport and whole-force totals are absent, and some role lines have blanks. Do not treat 5,072 as whole-force aircraft strength or back-fill missing aircraft categories with zero.

limitations: Fifty hand-transcribed return dates from nine source pages; many source pages remain untranscribed; no claim to full chronological coverage.
Values are on hand or serviceable at a date, not the count of operational aircraft assigned to Europe or a particular theater.
The source classifies aircraft roles differently over time; compare whole-return totals only with adequate boundary notes.
The original is a postwar British compilation of German wartime returns; report date and compilation cutoff, definitions and omissions need audit against Bundesarchiv originals.
No map coordinates, casualties, combat missions or aircraft losses are implied by the table.
Source numerical error for 20 November 1944 is explicit: do not silently replace the original with our calculated candidate correction.
